General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Twin Grooved Crank Shaft Pulley.
This newer style pulley uses a Ribbed Belt which reduces slippage, squealing and belt twist compared to the V-Belt, resulting in longer belt life.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Crank Shaft Pulley
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models with 16V Engine
